title: Adaptive Climate Configuration
description: Single source of truth for the Adaptive Climate container. Everything downstream is a pure function of this document: the helper/automation generator, the section scheduler, the analyser, and the UI. Learned data (almanacs) is NOT stored here - it lives in the almanac store and is regenerated nightly.

version.description: Schema version. Bumped only on breaking changes; the container migrates forward on load.

access_token.description: Long-lived access token. Held in a separate secrets file at runtime (chmod 600) and REDACTED from any config export or backup download. Present in this schema only so the shape is documented.

reconnect_backoff_seconds.description: WebSocket reconnect ladder. Final value repeats indefinitely.

temperature_unit.description: Display and storage unit. Everything internal is in this unit; conversion, if any, is a UI concern. Lux had no unit; temperature does, and it scales the reactive delta and maintenance step below.

heartbeat_interval_minutes.description: Observation cadence. A heartbeat is DEFERRED (not skipped) while a room's guard boolean is on, so it never samples a unit mid-transition.

reactive_window_seconds.description: After the first user-originated setpoint change, the container keeps collecting further changes for this long before writing one consolidated reactive event.

reactive_min_delta.description: A unit's setpoint only counts as genuinely changed if |after - before| exceeds this many degrees. Filters out rounding noise and transition echo.

max_step_degrees.description: Maintenance nudges the setpoint by at most this many degrees per step (the '2 degrees at a time' rule).

correction_max_minutes.description: Safety cap: corrective action stops after this long even if the quorum is still met, or at the first heartbeat the tally drops below quorum - whichever comes first.

trust.description: Calibration of the sensor trust model. See docs/TRUST_MODEL.md.

high_trust_deviation.description: Reaction deviation (degrees) that maps to maximum trust and the tightest comfort band.

low_trust_deviation.description: Reaction deviation (degrees) that maps to minimum trust and the widest comfort band. New sensors with no reactions start here.

data_dir.description: Container volume root. Contains csv/, db/, almanac/, config/.

csv_enabled.description: Write human-readable CSV alongside SQLite. SQLite is always rebuildable from CSV, so the container holds no irreplaceable state.

event_log_retention_days.description: Retention for the UI event log. Heartbeat and reactive history are never auto-pruned.

external_guards.description: Entity ids of input_booleans another system raises while it controls the thermostats. While any is on, setpoint changes are attributed to that system rather than the user. For coexistence during cutover; normally empty.

learning.description: Analyser tuning. Defaults reproduce the proven Light behaviour for setpoint learning; trust-specific knobs live under system.trust.

analysis_window_days.description: Rolling window for the nightly rebuild (three weeks).

bootstrap_min_days.description: Below this many days of data the almanac is published immediately (bootstrap); at or above it, publication waits the validity delay (learning).

validity_delay_days.description: In the learning state, a new almanac only takes effect after this delay, so a single odd day cannot swing behaviour.

reactive_weight.description: A reactive event counts this many times a heartbeat. You correcting the system is its most valuable signal.

schedule_profiles.description: Named time profiles. A room selects one by id; several rooms can share one.

id.description: Stable identifier. Load-bearing: every generated helper and automation is named from this, never from 'name'. Never change it once deployed.

name.description: Display name. Free text, changeable at will.

schedule_profile.description: Which schedule_profile this room follows, by id.

units.description: The AC units in this room, each an HA climate entity.

sensors.description: Temperature sensors in this room. Each learns its own comfort reading, band and trust.

presence_sensors.description: RESERVED. Optional occupancy sensors. Not yet used - reserved so occupancy can be added without a schema migration. See docs/DESIGN.md open decisions.

scenes.description: Per-section auto/off matrix, keyed by section id. Absent sections default every unit to auto.

id.description: Stable per-unit id, used in almanac rows and generated references.

entity_id.description: The HA climate (thermostat) entity, e.g. climate.lounge_ac. Chosen from a live picker so a typo cannot resolve to 'unknown'.

leak_detection.description: Optional. When enabled, the generator emits input_boolean.ac_leak_<room>_<unit> plus a stub automation you wire your own leak sensor into. Leak mode is a latch (see docs/DESIGN.md D6).

entity_id.description: The HA temperature sensor entity, e.g. sensor.lounge_temperature.

scene.description: What one section does. Auto/off is per unit; a unit set 'off' is baked into the automation directly and holds from first deploy.

transition_seconds.description: How long the crossover takes to apply.

units.description: Keyed by unit id. 'auto' = follow the almanac; 'off' = force this unit off for this section.

sections.description: All six sections, in canonical order (sunrise -> sleep). Times should increase through the day.

id.description: Canonical section identifier. Fixed set - these six and only these six. These are SECTION names, not astronomical events: climate has no sun-relative triggers.

name.description: Display name. Free text; only id is load-bearing.

trigger.description: A fixed clock time. Climate has no sun-relative or composite triggers - it follows your routine, not the sun.
